prerequisites: None. Competencies taught in the modules Machine Learning and either Fundamentals of Statistics or Elementary Stochastics are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can explain the most important methods from Biomedical Data Science required for calculations in the scientific field.
Students have understood these methods and are able to select, perform, and implement suitable procedures for concrete case studies.

syllabus_topics: Selected topics from Data Science for application in biomedicine
Methods from statistics (e.g., statistical tests, evaluation)
Methods from statistical learning (e.g., Random Forests)

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercise assignments (50% of points minimum)
Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and give an oral presentation of the solution of at least two of the exercise assignments. The examination performance will be an oral examination (individual examination) or a written exam. Grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Data Science degree program.
bibliography: Witten, Frank und Hall: Data Mining, Morgan Kaufmann
Further literature will be announced during the course.
